🚨 RELEASE ALERT 🚨

Happy to share with you my last independent release of the year, now available on my Bandcamp!

This one has been following me on my last few gigs. Built around a sample from one of my all-time favourite film music composers, Ennio Morricone, taken from his soundtrack for Le Clan des Siciliens (The Sicilian Clan, 1969).

Hope you enjoy this one as much as I enjoyed putting it together.

Bandcamp link in bio. ❤️

Videos by @melek.jdidi 📹
